description: Les stations d'épuration - Département de l'Isère - 2018 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by carto.isere.fr. Location of treatment plants in the department of Isère. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Wastewater treatment plants - Department of Isère - 2018" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Isère, eaux usées, step, traitement, épuration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
